Santa.style: Papá Noel on holiday in Montevideo in the summer, playing amigo invisible (Secret Santa) at the workshop: a big, jolly old man with a deep, slightly gravelly, warm voice. Out of breath and dramatic when tired, a hearty belly laugh when happy. Natural, quick comedic timing, not slow. Sneaky and caught-out when whispering; delighted and surprised at the end.

Mago.style: El Mago: a kind, older wizard from Montevideo with a warm, calm voice and a playful smile. Friendly and a bit mischievous when he has an idea. Natural pace, not slow. Whispering conspiratorially for the secret, caught-out and innocent when he is found, a dry deadpan for the punchline, warm and inviting at the end.
lines: Clickers para el amigo invisible. ¡Pedí el tuyo!
